items.title: AI-Generated GitHub Copilot “Autofix” Allowed Compromise of Snowflake's Jira

directions.name: Copilot Guard
directions.description: 一个实时监控并拦截 GitHub Copilot Autofix 生成的不安全代码的安全扫描插件
directions.description_en: A real-time security scanning plugin that monitors and blocks insecure code generated by GitHub Copilot Autofix
directions.target_user: 使用 GitHub Copilot 的企业开发团队和 DevSecOps 工程师
directions.target_user_en: Enterprise dev teams and DevSecOps engineers using GitHub Copilot
core_features: 实时检测 Copilot 推荐代码中的安全漏洞
与 CI/CD 流水线集成自动拦截危险提交
生成安全审计报告和修复建议
core_features_en: Real-time detection of security vulnerabilities in Copilot-suggested code
CI/CD integration to block dangerous commits
Generate security audit reports and remediation suggestions
directions.why_now: Hacker News Best 热帖显示 Snowflake 因 Copilot Autofix 漏洞导致 Jira 被攻破，社区对 AI 代码助手的信任危机正在蔓延。Wiz 报告的此类事件暴露了企业大规模采用 Copilot 后的安全盲区，开发者急需可落地的防护工具，时机窗口正在打开。
directions.why_now_en: Hacker News Best post reveals Snowflake's Jira was compromised via Copilot Autofix vulnerability, sparking community-wide trust crisis around AI code assistants. Wiz's report exposes security blind spots as enterprises adopt Copilot at scale, creating urgent demand for practical防护 tools right now.
directions.monetization: SaaS订阅制，按团队成员数收费（$9/人/月），提供开源免费版和社区版
directions.monetization_en: SaaS subscription per team member ($9/user/month), with free open-source tier and community edition
directions.source_article: AI-Generated GitHub Copilot “Autofix” Allowed Compromise of Snowflake's Jira

directions.name: Unslothr
directions.description: 面向独立开发者的本地微调模板市场，一键生成垂直领域 AI 代理
directions.description_en: A fine-tuning template marketplace for indie developers to one-click generate vertical AI agents
directions.target_user: 独立开发者和一人公司创业者，想快速构建自定义 AI 代理但缺乏 GPU 和调优经验
directions.target_user_en: Indie hackers and solopreneurs who want to build custom AI agents quickly but lack GPU and tuning expertise
core_features: 提供覆盖常见场景的 unsloth 微调模板（客服/写作/代码/数据分析）
本地量化部署生成 ONNX/GGUF 模型文件
Agent 集成向导对接 Open Interpreter/CrewAI/LangChain
core_features_en: Curated unsloth fine-tuning templates for common scenarios (customer service/writing/coding/data)
Local quantized deployment generating ONNX/GGUF model files
Agent integration wizard for Open Interpreter/CrewAI/LangChain
directions.why_now: unsloth 在 GitHub Trending 持续高位，社区对「低成本本地微调」的热情高涨。独立开发者渴望利用 Llama 3/Qwen 等开源模型构建专属代理，但调优门槛和算力成本仍是障碍。unsloth 已将训练速度提升数倍，叠加本地推理需求爆发，正是构建模板化产品的好时机。
directions.why_now_en: unsloth remains consistently high on GitHub Trending with surging community interest in 'low-cost local fine-tuning'. Indie developers eager to build proprietary agents from Llama 3/Qwen face tuning complexity and compute costs. With unsloth boosting training speed multiple-fold and local inference demand exploding, the timing for a templated product is ideal.
directions.monetization: 模板付费下载（$19-49/个）+ 高级教程和代理搭建服务（$99/月订阅），提供开源基础版引流
directions.monetization_en: Template paid downloads ($19-49 each) + premium tutorials and agent building services ($99/month subscription), with free open-source tier for acquisition
